 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Atul Choudhary - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Vineeta Sharma - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is the second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.132/2023 registered at Police Station - Gadasarai, District- Dindori (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3, 4, 5(L) and 6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 03.01.2024.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 03.01.2024.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C has stated that she herself went to the applicant but later on under the pressure of her parents, she has stated against the present applicant in the Court statement.

It is further stated that from the statement of the prosecutrix, it is clear that although she is minor according to biological factor but she was well aware about the facts and she herself went to the applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of the trial will take NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46154 2 MCRC-33420-2024 considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

3. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that at the time of incident age of the prosecutrix was 16 years and 6 months and she was pregnant.
Prosecutrix and her sister in their Court statement have deposed against the applicant.
Therefore, he prayed for rejection of the application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
